    Naming your Ranger

    The Ranger is Aion 2's long-range physical damage dealer, fighting with a bow and traps while keeping enemies at a distance. Ranger names work best when they feel natural and swift: soft consonants, airy vowels and endings like -wyn, -ra and -el.

    Elyos Rangers fit sylvan, almost elven names such as Sylwyn or Lirael. Asmodian Rangers can go darker and more predatory with names like Fenrak or Ravenshot. The compound tone mixes your faction's words with hunter terms like arrow, hawk, quill, strider and snare.

    Quick tips

    • Nature roots (Syl-, Fen-, Ash-, Lir-) give a woodland feel.
    • Bird and wind themes suit a class that fights from range: Skyhawk, Galequill.
    • Two syllables are ideal: easy to type in party chat and quick to shout.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What are good Ranger names for Aion 2?

    Sylwyn, Fenara, Lirael, Dawnarrow and Ravenshot are good starting points. Set the class to Ranger above for endless variations.

    Does the generator check if a Ranger name is available?

    No tool outside the game can check live availability. Generate a shortlist, save your favorites with the ☆ button, then try them at character creation. If one is taken, use ↻ to get spelling variants.

    How do I use the Ranger name generator?

    The class is already set to Ranger. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
